title: The Relic Seller
text: A man at the roadside sells holy relics from a blanket: a saint's finger, a feather from an angel, a bottle of the Six's tears. Most of it is fake, and he knows you know. One small box at the back he keeps a hand on.

options.label: The sharpest eye picks the one that looks least fake, and pays for the gamble.

outcomes.text: It is real. He did not know.

options.label: Expose him to the other pilgrims, and let them deal with him.

outcomes.text: They take his stall apart, and him with it, and thank you.

options.label: The shrewdest offers to sell for him, for a cut of the pilgrims' coin.

outcomes.text: Pilgrims are easy marks, and the gold is heavy, and so is the feeling.
